title: Annual ice loss: mountain glaciers vs. the Greenland ice sheet

source.name: Glacier Mass Balance Intercomparison Exercise (GlaMBIE)
source.publisher: World Glacier Monitoring Service (WGMS), University of Zurich

notes: GlaMBIE researchers report that recent mountain-glacier mass loss (about 390 billion tonnes/year) now runs about 18% larger than losses from the Greenland ice sheet over the same period. Greenland figure derived from that reported ratio; approximate as publicly reported.
